subject: Money
title: The Laffer Curve
description: Learn The Laffer Curve in one minute.

hook.text: In 1974, economist Arthur Laffer drew a curve on a napkin at dinner. It changed tax policy forever.

buildup.text: The idea: at 0% tax, revenue is zero. At 100% tax, nobody works, so revenue is also zero.

discovery.text: Somewhere between 0% and 100% is a peak where revenue is maximized. Cut rates and revenue might rise.

twist.text: Reagan used this to justify huge tax cuts. Revenue didn't rise—the deficit tripled instead.

climax.text: The Laffer Curve is real in theory. But nobody agrees where the peak is. That's the whole problem.

quiz.question: What does the Laffer Curve suggest?
options: There's an optimal tax rate that maximizes revenue
